question: On one unchanged August 1-through-28 native real-tick fingerprint, does the already fixed replacement-development contract materially outperform the exact active Live-derived control?

proxy_authorization.authority: one paired native relative check only

adjacent_fingerprint_contract.compiled_ex5: one byte-identical file for both runs
adjacent_fingerprint_contract.runtime_type: new dedicated physical non-Master Optimization Portable
unchanged_between_runs: US30, US100 and US500 base and Tester tick/history files
August 1 inclusive to August 29 exclusive dates
USD 100 deposit, USD currency, 1:100 leverage and execution mode
formula, clocks, stops, sizing, reserve/headroom and cost observation
allowed_differences: the eight declared aggregate-risk and component-multiplier input values
role-specific SET path, report path and archived output root
adjacent_fingerprint_contract.between_run_action: stop the first terminal, preserve its complete role artifacts, remove only generated mutable Tester Files/log/report material from the dedicated runtime, then launch the second config without source, binary, history or tick mutation
adjacent_fingerprint_contract.mid_matrix_drift: invalid matrix correction state with both paths restarted

economic_contract.tester_model: MT5 every tick based on real ticks
mandatory_validity: both reports complete normally with 100 percent real ticks
both role outputs are finite, internally consistent and attributable
normal Tester stop and zero safety, persistence, broker, foreign-exposure, protection or research-drop fault
candidate reproduces its frozen native August anchor
same-fingerprint adjacency contract has no drift
core_relative_support: candidate actual and doubled-observed-cost-stressed net are positive
candidate stressed net exceeds control by at least USD 5
candidate stressed profit factor exceeds control
candidate native maximum relative equity drawdown is at or below the practical 21.2 percent envelope
economic_contract.practical_drawdown_rule: A candidate-minus-control native DD excess above nominal 5.0 but at or below 7.5 percentage points may be accepted only if every core support condition and all three non-DD contextual checks pass; nominal and practical judgments are both disclosed.
economic_contract.invalid_environment_or_engineering_attem: correction states with no arbitrary count cap and no economic verdict
